headline: Trump heads to Asia for Xi and Putin talks; flight delays drag into Monday; calls grow for Huang's return

texas.headline: Teachers and parents welcome prospect of an educator as Texas schools chief
texas.summary: Texas' next education commissioner is expected to come from a teaching background, a change teachers and parents say is overdue.

texas.headline: Profile: Democrat Ben Flores, Texas' incoming land commissioner
texas.summary: The Tribune profiles the cancer survivor and immigrant who will next lead the General Land Office.

us.headline: Trump leaves for Asia to meet Xi and Putin as Nvidia fallout lingers
us.summary: The president's trip includes meetings with China's and Russia's leaders while the Nvidia leadership crisis hangs over US-China tech ties.

us.headline: Airline disruptions from the ground stop expected to last into Monday
us.summary: Carriers are still working through cancellations and delays left by Friday's nationwide halt to flights.

us.headline: Duffy ties ground stop to contractor work on old copper lines
us.summary: The transportation secretary said a contractor upgrading aging copper wiring set off the failure behind the flight stoppage.

australia.headline: Helen Haines leaves hospital
australia.summary: Politicians across parties welcomed news that the independent federal MP has been released from hospital.

australia.headline: Youth boot camps and stalking pledge scrutinised in Victorian campaign
australia.summary: Election promises on youth 'boot camps' and tougher anti-stalking laws drew questions on the campaign trail.

australia.headline: ASX slips as mining shares weigh
australia.summary: The Australian share market fell on Monday, led lower by the big miners.

ai.headline: Calls grow across the tech world for Jensen Huang to return to Nvidia
ai.summary: More industry figures are publicly backing a comeback for the chipmaker's departed co-founder and chief executive.

ai.headline: Futures dip ahead of a week with Nvidia earnings and Anthropic's IPO
ai.summary: Stock futures opened lower Sunday as investors looked toward Nvidia's quarterly report and Anthropic's market debut.

tech.headline: Coles investigates a cybersecurity incident
tech.summary: The Australian supermarket group said it is looking into a cyber incident but has released few details so far.

world.headline: Southeast Asian leaders meet as Trump heads to the Philippines
world.summary: The annual ASEAN summit opened with regional conflicts high on the agenda, with the US president due to attend.

world.headline: ASEAN nations sign a digital trade pact
world.summary: Southeast Asian countries agreed a deal meant to simplify cross-border payments and reduce trade paperwork.

world.headline: Zelenskyy asks US and Musk to restore Starlink after Russian strikes
world.summary: Ukraine's president appealed for satellite internet access to be restored following a new wave of Russian attacks.

world.headline: Sweden pushes new EU plan to tap frozen Russian assets for Ukraine
world.summary: Stockholm called on the bloc to find a fresh way to release immobilised Russian funds to support Kyiv.

world.headline: Prince Harry makes surprise weekend visit to Ukraine
world.summary: The Duke of Sussex travelled to Ukraine unannounced and voiced confidence in the country's eventual victory.

aus-cricket.headline: Annabel Sutherland ruled out for the rest of WBBL|12
aus-cricket.summary: A hamstring tendon injury sidelines the Melbourne Stars and Australia all-rounder for the remainder of the season.

aus-cricket.headline: Victoria beat Western Australia in Shield round four
aus-cricket.summary: Victoria won their round-four match against WA, and both sides welcomed the prospect of a Boxing Day Shield fixture at the MCG.

warriors.headline: Warriors face the slumping Pelicans on Monday
warriors.summary: Golden State meet New Orleans, who arrive on a six-game losing streak, as the Warriors look to bounce back from their loss in San Antonio.
